item.title: Ep. 1: Preventing Multi-Chain Address Poisoning & Missing Memo Loss Across 46+ Blockchains
item.itunes:title: Preventing Multi-Chain Address Poisoning & Missing Memo Loss Across 46+ Blockchains
item.itunes:author: AllSwap Security Labs
item.description:
In Episode 1, the AllSwap Security Engineering team analyzes two major operational failure modes in cross-chain cryptocurrency settlements across 46+ blockchain networks: prefix/suffix vanity address-poisoning lookalike attacks and omitted mandatory Memo / Destination Tag routing identifiers on shared custodial settlement endpoints (XRP Ledger, Stellar, Cosmos Hub, TON, Hedera, EOS).

Resources & Reference Links:

  • Interactive Multi-Chain Address & Memo Validator: https://allswap.io/tools/address-validator
  • AllSwap Non-Custodial Cross-Chain Swap & Bridge Aggregator: https://allswap.io
  • AllSwap Protocol Documentation: https://allswap.io/docs
  • Open-Source CLI & Test Suite (MIT): https://github.com/zhangglnuo-art/multichain-memo-address-validator
